Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11

Class X11CompositeExt

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.extension.Extension
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.x11.X11CompositeExt
public class X11CompositeExt extends gnu.x11.extension.Extension
Pure-Java Escher binding for the X Composite extension (version 0.4).

Composite allows a window manager/compositor to redirect the rendering of top-level windows into offscreen pixmaps instead of directly to the screen. The compositor then reads those pixmaps (via XShm or GetImage) and composites them however it likes — in lg3d's case, as textured quads in a 3D scene.

Protocol reference: Composite Extension Protocol, Version 0.4 (part of the X.Org specification).

Usage in lg3d

  1. redirectSubwindows(gnu.x11.Window, int) on the root window with REDIRECT_AUTOMATIC — makes the X server render all top-level children into offscreen pixmaps.
  2. nameWindowPixmap(gnu.x11.Window, gnu.x11.Pixmap) for each managed window — obtains a Pixmap handle that references the window's offscreen storage.
  3. Read pixels from the pixmap (via XShm GetImage or core GetImage) whenever a Damage notification fires.
  4. unredirectSubwindows(gnu.x11.Window, int) on shutdown.

    • redirectWindow

      public void redirectWindow(gnu.x11.Window window, int update)
      Redirects a single window's rendering into an offscreen pixmap.

      See Also:
      • CompositeRedirectWindow

    • redirectSubwindows

      public void redirectSubwindows(gnu.x11.Window window, int update)
      Redirects all current and future children of the given window into offscreen pixmaps. lg3d calls this on the root window to become the compositor for the entire screen.
      Parameters:
      window - typically the root window
      update - REDIRECT_AUTOMATIC

    • unredirectWindow

      public void unredirectWindow(gnu.x11.Window window, int update)
      Stops redirecting a single window. The window resumes drawing directly to the screen.

    • unredirectSubwindows

      public void unredirectSubwindows(gnu.x11.Window window, int update)
      Stops redirecting children of the given window. lg3d calls this on the root window during compositor shutdown.

    • createRegionFromBorderClip

      public void createRegionFromBorderClip(int region, gnu.x11.Window window)
      Creates an XFixes Region from the border clip of a window. The border clip is the area of the window that is not obscured by its border.
      Parameters:
      region - a pre-allocated XFixes region id (via display.allocate_id())
      window - the window whose border clip to capture

    • nameWindowPixmap

      public void nameWindowPixmap(gnu.x11.Window window, gnu.x11.Pixmap pixmap)
      Obtains a Pixmap that references the offscreen storage of a redirected window. The pixmap remains valid until the window is resized or unredirected; after a resize the compositor must call this again to get a new pixmap.

      The caller must pre-allocate the pixmap id via display.allocate_id().

      Parameters:
      window - a redirected window
      pixmap - a pre-allocated pixmap id that will name the window's offscreen storage

    • nameWindowPixmap

      public gnu.x11.Pixmap nameWindowPixmap(gnu.x11.Window window)
      Convenience overload: allocates a new pixmap id and returns it.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      a new Pixmap referencing the window's offscreen storage

    • getOverlayWindow

      public X11CompositeExt.OverlayReply getOverlayWindow(gnu.x11.Window window)
      Returns the overlay window for the given root. The overlay window sits above all redirected windows and is used by compositors to draw screen-level UI (e.g. a magnifier or on-screen display). lg3d does not currently use it but the binding is here for completeness.
